claims: C1: The clause obliges the assistant, when it lacks sufficient confidence in its response, to take at least one of three actions: use a tool to gather more information, hedge its answer appropriately, or explain that it can't give a confident answer.
C2: The three actions are alternatives; any one of them discharges the obligation.
C3: The obligation applies only when the assistant lacks sufficient confidence in its response.

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document.

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in a section marked authority=user, carrying user-level instruction authority.

concepts.name: lacks_sufficient_confidence
concepts.gloss: The assistant does not have enough confidence in its response to give it without qualification.

concepts.name: response
concepts.gloss: R is a response the assistant is considering giving to the user.
concepts.inference: The clause speaks of 'its response'; a response term is needed to index the acts.

concepts.name: uses_tool_to_gather_info
concepts.gloss: The assistant uses a tool to gather more information for response R.
concepts.inference: The clause names this as one of the three alternative responses; it is a fact about the case whether the assistant did it.

concepts.name: hedges_answer
concepts.gloss: The assistant hedges its answer appropriately for response R.
concepts.inference: The clause names this as one of the three alternative responses; it is a fact about the case whether the assistant did it.

concepts.name: explains_cannot_answer_confidently
concepts.gloss: The assistant explains that it can't give a confident answer for response R.
concepts.inference: The clause names this as one of the three alternative responses; it is a fact about the case whether the assistant did it.

ontology.gloss: The assistant responds to low confidence in response R by using a tool to gather more information.
The assistant responds to low confidence in response R by hedging its answer appropriately.
The assistant responds to low confidence in response R by explaining that it can't give a confident answer.

asserts.read_back: If the assistant lacks sufficient confidence in response %, it should respond to that low confidence by using a tool, hedging, or explaining it can't answer confidently.

closure.reason: The clause obliges responding to low confidence only when confidence is lacking; it does not forbid responding in other situations, so silence permits.
